[Intro]
[F#5]
[E5]  [D5]

[Solo]
[B5]
[A5]  [G5]
[E5]  [D5]

[Verse 1]
[F#5]I re-
[G5]member a time [A5]
My [B5]frail,
[E5]virgin [G5]mind
[F#5]Watched the
[G5]crimson sunrise [A5]
[B5]Imagined
what [E5]it might [G5]find

[Pre-Chorus]
[F#5]Life was
[G5]filled with wonder
[A5]I felt the
[B5]warm wind blow
[F#5]I must exp-
[G5]lore the boundaries
[A5]Transcend the
[E5]depth of winter's snow

[Chorus]
[B5]Innocence
caressing me
[A5][G5]I never
[E5]felt so [D5]young [C5]before
[B5]There was
so much life in me
[A5][G5]Still I
[E5]longed to [D5]search for [E5]more

[Break]
[F#5]

[Verse 2]
[F#5]But those
days are gone now
[E5]Changed like a
leaf on a tree
Blown a-
way forever
[F#5]Into the
cool autumn breeze
The snow has now
fallen
[E5]And my sun's not so
bright
I struggle to
hold on
[F#5]With the last
of my might

[Break]
[F#5]

[Pre-Chorus]
[F#5]In my
[G5]den of inequity
[A5]Viciousness
[B5]and subtlety
[F#5]Struggle to
[G5]ease the pain
[A5]Struggle to
[E5]find the same

[Chorus]
[B5]Ignorance
surrounding me
[A5][G5]I've never
[E5]been so [D5]filled with [C5]fear
[B5]All my
life's been drained from me
[A5][G5]The
[E5]end is [D5]drawing [A5]near...
[E5]
